'''D0-5K''' was an [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was present at [[Strike Base XR-484]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=location|Ossus}}</ref>
